meta.title: B2B SEO Consultant | CommView
meta.description: SEO consultant for B2B scale-ups. Technical, content and AEO combined around commercial search demand, not vanity rankings.

hero.sub: SEO should connect search demand to commercial intent. We find the searches that matter to your buyers, fix the technical and content barriers, build the pages worth finding and measure whether visibility turns into useful business behaviour.

diagram.caption: MODERN SEO
diagram.sub: Visibility is only useful when it reaches the right buyer.

sections.heading: What a Modern SEO Consultant Actually Does
intro: Modern SEO is not a monthly ranking report. It combines technical discoverability, search intent, useful content and the way buyers increasingly find answers through both search engines and AI interfaces.
The work starts by understanding what the business needs to be found for, why those searches matter commercially and whether the existing site deserves to rank for them.

sections.heading: How Commview Does B2B SEO Differently
sections.intro: Volume is evidence, not the strategy. We prioritise search opportunities around buyer fit, intent and the commercial job of the page.

items.title: Commercial keywords first
items.body: Prioritise searches that connect to a real buyer problem, service or decision rather than chasing volume for its own sake.

items.title: SEO and AEO together
items.body: Structure useful content so it can perform in traditional search and be understood, extracted and cited by AI answer experiences.

items.title: Technical and content connected
items.body: Fix discoverability and site structure while building the pages the search demand actually requires.

items.title: Measure beyond rankings
items.body: Track non-brand visibility, useful traffic, conversion behaviour and downstream commercial signals where the data allows.

sections.heading: SEO for B2B and SaaS Needs a Different Commercial Lens
sections.intro: Long buying cycles and smaller addressable markets change what useful search traffic looks like.

columns.title: High-volume SEO thinking
items: Optimise for the largest reachable audience
Treat traffic growth as the primary success signal

columns.title: B2B commercial SEO
items: Connect content to complex buying decisions
Build service, use-case, comparison and evidence pages around the journey

sections.heading: What You Get From an SEO Consultant Engagement

items.title: Audit
items.body: Technical, content and search-demand review focused on the constraints that materially affect discoverability.

items.title: Strategy
items.body: Keyword and page ownership mapped to the commercial priorities of the business.

items.title: Content plan
items.body: A prioritised roadmap of pages and content based on buyer intent, gaps and opportunity.

items.title: Execution
items.body: Hands-on content, on-page and implementation work, with specialist support brought in where needed.

items.title: Reporting
items.body: A measurement view that separates brand from non-brand performance and keeps rankings connected to useful behaviour.

items.a: An SEO consultant helps a business improve how it is discovered through search by connecting technical site health, search demand, content and page structure. For B2B companies, the useful work goes further than rankings. It should prioritise searches that match the right buyers and connect visibility to meaningful commercial behaviour.

items.q: SEO consultant vs SEO agency: which is right for us?
items.a: A consultant can suit a business that needs senior diagnosis, prioritisation and hands-on direction without buying a large agency team. An agency can be useful when substantial specialist production capacity is required. Commview can set the commercial SEO direction, execute directly and bring in specialist expertise where the work requires it.

items.q: How long until we see SEO results?
items.a: There is no responsible fixed timeline for SEO results. Timing depends on the site's current authority, technical condition, competition, content gaps and the searches being targeted. Some technical or existing-page improvements can move sooner than new competitive content. We establish the baseline first and measure progress against the specific opportunity.

items.q: How much does an SEO consultant cost?
items.a: SEO consulting cost depends on whether the work is a focused audit, a strategy project or ongoing execution across technical SEO, content and measurement. Commview does not publish a single standard price because the scope varies materially. We define the commercial problem and required work before agreeing the engagement.

sections.heading: SEO traffic is not the goal. Being found by the right buyer for the right reason is.
sections.body: We can work out where search can contribute to growth and what needs to change to capture it.
